name: IANA Time Zone Database 2026b
note: The tz database is the authority every operating system, language runtime and
database resolves time zones against. Its maintainers place it in the public domain
(see the `LICENSE` file in the distribution), so unlike most reference data there is
Releases are immutable and versioned by year plus a letter, which is what makes a
pinned integrity hash meaningful: 2026b will always be 2026b.
